formulas.estimates: elliptical torus internal volume; casing area × construction thickness + tread volume; 1120 kg/m³ material prior
formulas.surfaceHeat: FRICTION_K from compound, load ratio/density and driven duty; PERFORMANCE_CURVE is not used as a heat source
formulas.rollingHeat: SURFACE_ROLLING_K and CARCASS_ROLLING_K from rolling resistance, construction flex, load and driven duty
formulas.cooling: COOL_FACTOR × SURFACE_TO_AMBIENT is solved as one speed/area/volume-coupled pathway
formulas.conduction: bidirectional surface/carcass/core paths from geometry, construction, volume, pressure and area
formulas.brake: BRAKE_TO_CORE from imported/derived axle brake exposure and internal volume
formulas.evidence: coefficients are reconstruction priors; confidence affects reporting only, never secretly scales physics

sources.schema: CSP Cars – Tyre Thermal Models (V1/V2), revised 2026-06-06
sources.rays: CSP Cars – Tyre Physics extended-ray schema; ACLM uses 2 lateral and 4 longitudinal rays per side as a bounded V2 thermal-distribution compromise
sources.pathways: ACLM evidence-marked heat-pathway reconstruction prior; telemetry calibration required

historicalLife.lifeBasis: Period R5/D9 Goodwood abrasion evidence: 45–50 miles/mm racing with 6 mm durability tread implies roughly 435–483 km full-tread abrasion on old surface; resurfacing could improve wear dramatically. This constrains scale, not wear→grip shape.

acImplementation.wearCurve: maps AC virtual exposure to AC grip-health; not physical tread depth

referenceDuty.incidentPolicy: incident/abuse runs demonstrate stress sensitivity but are excluded from clean stint-life fitting
